core_categories: Pharmaceuticals; Biologics; Traditional Chinese Medicines; Drug Distribution; Logistics; Retail Pharmacy
specialty_focus: Shanghai Pharmaceuticals Distribution is a major Chinese biopharmaceutical enterprise and the second-largest medical distributor in China. It operates as a manufacturer, retailer, wholesaler, and distributor of healthcare products, with a focus on nationwide drug distribution, warehousing, logistics, and retail pharmacy chains. It does not specifically deal in wearable medical devices.
